SET DC_KIND="AUTO";
DEFINE TABLE '$TTable1' :=
SELECT
    'DimService'[service_name],
    'DimRegion'[region],
    SUM ( 'FactsCost'[unblended_cost] )
FROM 'FactsCost'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN 'DimService'
        ON 'FactsCost'[Dim_Service.service_key]='DimService'[service_key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN 'DimRegion'
        ON 'FactsCost'[Dim_Region.region_key]='DimRegion'[region_key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN 'DimDate'
        ON 'FactsCost'[Dim_Date.date_key]='DimDate'[date_key]
WHERE
    'DimDate'[date] ININDEX '$TTable2'[$SemijoinProjection];

WHERE

SUM([Facts Cost (10)].[unblended cost (75)]) AS [$Measure0]

	LEFT OUTER JOIN [Dim Service (16)] ON [Facts Cost (10)].[Dim Service service key (73)]=[Dim Service (16)].[service key (83)]
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [Dim Region (19)] ON [Facts Cost (10)].[Dim Region region key (71)]=[Dim Region (19)].[region key (86)]

CommandText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('DimDate'[date])),
			AND('DimDate'[date] >= DATE(2024, 8, 1), 'DimDate'[date] < DATE(2026, 8, 1))
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('DimService'[service_name], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('DimRegion'[region], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Total_Cost", '_Measures'[Total Cost]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			102,
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'DimService'[service_name], [IsGrandTotalRowTotal]),
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'DimService'[service_name],
			0
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'DimRegion'[region], [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 1, 'DimRegion'[region], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal],
				ASC,
				'DimRegion'[region],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 'DimRegion'[region]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'DimService'[service_name] DESC, [ColumnIndex]
